keys.admin.config.server.title: Server Configuration
keys.admin.config.server.subtitle: Changes applied in real time without restart. Persisted in runtime-overrides.json
keys.admin.config.meta.MAX_PLAYERS_PER_GAME.d: Maximum number of players that can join a room. Once the limit is reached, new attempts receive "room full".
keys.admin.config.meta.MAX_LOBBIES.label: Max simultaneous lobbies
keys.admin.config.meta.MAX_LOBBIES.desc: Active games at the same time. When the limit is reached, no new rooms can be created until one finishes.
keys.admin.config.meta.QUESTION_TIME_LIMIT.de: Seconds available to answer. Affects speed bonus: faster answers earn more points. Recommended: 15–60 s.
How often (ms) the server removes inactive games from memory. 3,600,000 ms = 1 hour. Very low values increase server load.
keys.admin.config.meta.BASE_POINTS.label: Base points per correct answer
keys.admin.config.meta.BASE_POINTS.desc: Points awarded for a correct answer regardless of time. Always added to the speed bonus.
keys.admin.config.meta.MAX_TIME_BONUS.label: Maximum speed bonus
keys.admin.config.meta.MAX_TIME_BONUS.desc: Maximum extra points for fast answers. Distributed proportionally to remaining time. Set 0 to disable the speed bonus.
keys.admin.config.meta.STREAK_THRESHOLD.label: Streak activation threshold
keys.admin.config.meta.STREAK_THRESHOLD.desc: This setting is now configured individually within each game.
keys.admin.config.meta.STREAK_BONUS_PERCENTAG: This setting is now configured individually within each game.
keys.admin.config.meta.LOG_LEVEL.label: Log level
keys.admin.config.meta.LOG_LEVEL.desc: "debug" logs everything. "info" normal events. "warn" warnings only. "error" failures only. Production: "warn".
keys.admin.config.meta.LOG_MAX_SIZE.label: Max log file size
keys.admin.config.meta.LOG_MAX_SIZE.desc: File is rotated when this size is exceeded. Example: "20m" = 20 MB. Important on NAS with limited space.
keys.admin.config.meta.LOG_MAX_FILES.label: Log file retention
keys.admin.config.meta.LOG_MAX_FILES.desc: How long logs are kept. Example: "14d" = 14 days. Longer retention = more disk space.
keys.admin.config.meta.RECONNECTION_TIMEOUT.d: Minutes the server keeps a disconnected player's state. If they reconnect before expiry, the game resumes.
keys.admin.config.meta.INACTIVE_GAME_THRESHOL: Hours of inactivity before a game is considered abandoned and cleared from memory.
keys.admin.config.meta.EMPTY_LOBBY_TIMEOUT.de: Minutes until a lobby with no players is automatically destroyed.
keys.admin.config.meta.TOP_PLAYERS_DURING_GAM: How many players are shown in the on-screen ranking. A high number may clutter the presenter view.
keys.admin.config.meta.CORS_ORIGIN.label: CORS_ORIGIN (HTTP)
keys.admin.config.meta.CORS_ORIGIN.desc: Comma-separated list of allowed HTTP origins. Example: https://xiro.your-domain.com,http://192.168.1.20:3000
keys.admin.config.meta.ALLOWED_ORIGINS.label: ALLOWED_ORIGINS (Socket.IO)
keys.admin.config.meta.ALLOWED_ORIGINS.desc: Comma-separated list of allowed WebSocket origins. Should include the same hosts as CORS.
keys.admin.config.meta.UMAMI_SERVER_URL.label: UMAMI Server
keys.admin.config.meta.UMAMI_SERVER_URL.desc: Umami analytics script URL. E.g., https://umami.yourdomain.com/script.js
keys.admin.config.meta.UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID.label: Website Id (Umami)
keys.admin.config.meta.BACKUP_SCHEDULE.label: Backup schedule
keys.admin.config.meta.BACKUP_SCHEDULE.desc: Frequency of automatic database backups. "Disabled" stops automatic backups.
Days backup files are kept before automatic deletion. Higher value = more disk space.
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_HOST.label: SMTP server (host)
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_HOST.desc: Outgoing mail server address. Example: smtp.gmail.com, smtp.office365.com.
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_PORT.label: SMTP port
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_PORT.desc: 587 for STARTTLS (recommended), 465 for SSL/TLS, 25 for unencrypted.
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_SECURE.label: Secure connection (SSL/TLS)
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_SECURE.desc: Enables direct SSL/TLS on port 465. For STARTTLS on 587, select "false".
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_USER.label: SMTP user
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_USER.desc: Email account used to authenticate and send messages.
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_PASS.label: SMTP password
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_PASS.desc: Password or app token for the SMTP user. Stored encrypted, never shown in plain text.
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_FROM.label: Sender address
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_FROM.desc: Name and address shown as the sender. Format: "Name" <email@domain.com>.
keys.admin.config.meta.CONTACT_TOKEN_SECRET.d: HMAC key for signing contact form anti-bot tokens. Change it to invalidate all active tokens.
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksShellSize.label: Firework size
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksShellSize.desc: Visual size of fireworks on the podium. 0 = small and subtle, 16 = huge and spectacular. Affects particle count.
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksFinaleMode.desc: Activates burst mode with multiple simultaneous fireworks. Off = normal pace, On = intense spectacle.
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksSimSpeed.label: Simulation speed
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksSimSpeed.desc: Animation speed. 1 = normal, <1 = slow motion, >1 = fast.
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksLaunchIntervalM: Minimum ms between firework launches. Lower values = higher frequency.
Maximum ms between launches. The system picks a random value between min and max.
Maximum simultaneous fireworks in grand finale. Higher values = more intense but more CPU load.
Visual duration of particle trails. Low values = more persistent trails, high values = more ephemeral.
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksStarWidth.label: Star width
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksStarWidth.desc: Width of main particle lines. Affects visibility and visual impact.
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksSparkWidth.desc: Width of secondary spark lines. Thicker sparks are more visible but may look less natural.
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksSound.label: Sound
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksSound.desc: Enables sound effects: launch, explosion, crackle and special effects.
keys.admin.config.fireworks.panel_subtitle: Customize the visual spectacle on the final podium
keys.admin.config.fireworks.panel_note: Changes apply automatically on the next final podium. Auto-launch is always active.
keys.admin.config.ui.tv_card_label: "TV Version" card on the home screen
keys.admin.config.ui.tv_card_desc: Shows or hides the card and link to tv.html on the home screen.
keys.admin.config.lambda.desc: Bayesian smoothing that balances teams of different sizes, avoiding statistical advantages for small teams.
keys.admin.license.format_check: Check that the key is correctly written before saving.
keys.admin.license.remote_rejected: The license is saved, but the remote validator has rejected it.
keys.admin.license.no_license_info: Enter a valid license to activate the service.
keys.admin.license.subtitle: Save your site license here and validate its status.
keys.admin.license.input_help: The license is stored in the database and automatically checked when opening this tab.
keys.admin.license.save_invalid_format: License saved, but the format is not valid.
keys.admin.license.save_invalid: License saved, but it is not valid.
keys.admin.groq.model_desc: Faster models generate questions instantly, while high-quality ones are more accurate at extracting information.
keys.admin.groq.delete_msg: Delete the Groq API key? The AI generator will stop working.
keys.admin.exempt.title: Editors' games
keys.admin.exempt.subtitle: Freed content behaves as if it belonged to the administrator: with an installation license it plays without limits; without it, the 10 players + presenter limit applies.
keys.admin.exempt.empty: There is no content created by editors.
keys.admin.publicurl.title: Server public URL
keys.admin.publicurl.subtitle: Used in email links (verification, registration) and in the PayPal return. Leave it empty to auto-detect it from the domain each user browses from.
